coverage.claim_universe: all CONFIRMED structural_tokens with root=fwh on the PRODUCTION_ACTIVE Tanzil snapshot
coverage.coverage_limit: This does not create derivative diversity and does not by itself authorize a bare-root semantic conclusion.

root_lexeme_form_separation.structural_root_observation: All 13 exact stem rows carry ROOT:fwh; this establishes a structural grouping only.
root_lexeme_form_separation.form_observation: Every exact row is a noun stem and the persisted form and POS fields are N; there is no verbal-form or distinct derivative contrast in the 13-token universe.
root_lexeme_form_separation.lexeme_level_inference: The two observed noun lemma annotations are consistently compatible with the bodily mouth across every local construction.
root_lexeme_form_separation.root_level_inference: UNRESOLVED: the Quran-internal set does not discriminate a concrete bodily-mouth root core from an oral-aperture/interface abstraction or from no separately recoverable abstraction beyond these noun lexemes.
root_lexeme_form_separation.prohibited_promotion: Do not promote the concrete lexical referent or contextual speech function into a bare-root semantic claim.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: قَدْ بَدَتِ ٱلْبَغْضَآءُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِى صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ
phrase_audit.observation: The mouth phrase is the marked source of what becomes manifest and is contrasted with chests.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Do not assign hatred, manifestation, hiddenness, or the mouth/chest contrast to ROOT:fwh.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ
phrase_audit.observation: The mouth is attached by bi to saying and is contrasted with hearts.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Do not make false saying, outwardness, or heart opposition part of ROOT:fwh.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ
phrase_audit.observation: The mouth marks the bodily means of a stated profession while the heart clause denies matching belief.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Belief, unbelief, profession, and hypocrisy belong to the saying and contrastive context, not ROOT:fwh.

phrase_audit.observation: The mouth is the marked means of placating effect and is contrasted with hearts.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Placating, refusal, insincerity, and the heart contrast are contextual contributions.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: ذَٰلِكَ قَوْلُهُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ يُضَٰهِـُٔونَ قَوْلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ
phrase_audit.observation: The noun qawl is separately present and the mouth phrase specifies the bodily means of their saying.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: The co-occurrence blocks silently redefining fwh as qawl itself or importing the content and comparison into the root.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ
phrase_audit.observation: The mouth is the marked means in an attempted extinguishing construction.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: The verse does not by itself distinguish breath, speech, or a broader figurative mechanism; none may be assigned to ROOT:fwh.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: كَبَٰسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَٰلِغِهِۦ
phrase_audit.observation: The singular mouth is a bodily participant in a reaching construction involving outstretched hands and water.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: The exact direction and participant reference of reaching remain local questions; the one singular lemma annotation cannot define a bare-root abstraction.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: فَرَدُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِىٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا
phrase_audit.observation: Hands and mouths are distinct bodily participants in a fi containment relation before a saying clause.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: The exact gesture, purpose, and discourse force are not fixed by ROOT:fwh and remain locally unresolved.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًا
phrase_audit.observation: A word is explicitly the thing exiting and the mouth is its source with min.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Word, exit, magnitude, and falsehood are supplied independently by the phrase and context.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ
phrase_audit.observation: Tongues and mouths occur as separately named bodily terms in adjacent constructions, and saying is separately lexicalized.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Do not merge mouth with tongue, saying, reception, or lack of knowledge at the root layer.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ
phrase_audit.observation: Qawl is separately lexicalized and the mouth phrase marks the bodily means in the first clause.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: The truth contrast and legal or relational effect of labels are not fwh semantics.

phrase_audit.exact_phrase: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم
phrase_audit.observation: Mouths, hands, and feet are separately named bodily participants; mouths are the target of sealing.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: Silencing is produced by khatm plus ala and the discourse; it is not the lexical or root meaning of fwh.

phrase_audit.observation: The mouth is again the marked means in the paired attempted extinguishing construction.
phrase_audit.overclaim_guard: The local mechanism remains underdetermined; the parallel does not create independent derivative evidence for a root core.

six_pressure_counter_cases.pressure: A speech-only or outward-expression definition must explain the bodily mouth in the hands, water, and reaching relation without importing speech.
Hands are put in mouths; any non-bodily universal must absorb a concrete containment relation, while the precise gesture remains unstated.
Mouths are sealed while hands speak and feet testify; the text distinguishes the named bodily participants from their contextual actions.
Abstract hatred becomes manifest from mouths, so a narrow physical-contact-only gloss cannot explain the source construction without contextual output.
A word exits from mouths and saying is separately named; this tests whether the candidate improperly equates mouth with word or speech.
The paired extinguishing construction is the strongest apparent nonliteral use and does not identify whether the local means is breath, speech, or another figurative relation.

hard_cases.issue: The exact local mechanism of extinguishing by mouths is not discriminated by the two parallel verses.
hard_cases.required_treatment: Keep breath, speech, and broader figurative-means readings unresolved; do not use any one of them as root evidence.

hard_cases.issue: The exact action and purpose of placing or returning hands in mouths are not specified by the local wording.
hard_cases.required_treatment: Retain only the resolvable bodily-part and containment observation.

hard_cases.issue: What exact manifestation carries hatred from mouths is not lexicalized in the phrase.
hard_cases.required_treatment: Retain source/output structure and leave the precise carrier unresolved.

hard_cases.issue: Tongue, mouth, reception, and saying co-occur and must not be collapsed into one root contribution.
hard_cases.required_treatment: Preserve separate lexical and constructional attribution.

strongest_counterexample.reason: Both occurrences place mouths in an extinguishing relation whose local mechanism is not made explicit, preventing a fully concrete root-level paraphrase from being demonstrated solely by the text.
strongest_counterexample.effect: Does not defeat the bodily lexeme reading, but blocks claiming that concrete corporeality rather than an oral-interface abstraction has been isolated as the root core.

strongest_competitor.boundary: It may describe a contextual role for a subset, but it cannot replace the bodily noun in the complete 13-token set.

lexeme_includes: the bodily mouth named in a reaching relation involving water and outstretched hands
the bodily mouth named as a container
the bodily mouth named as a sealed body part
the bodily mouth serving through construction as an output source or means
lexeme_and_root_exclude: the content, truth, falsehood, belief, unbelief, hatred, or placating effect of speech
sealing, reaching, containment, emergence, or instrumentality when these are supplied by verbs and prepositions
semantic_boundary.root_boundary: No separate abstract ROOT:fwh contribution is established beyond the shared structural key and the observed bodily-mouth noun lexemes.

layer_attribution.root: Structural grouping fwh only; semantic contribution unresolved.
layer_attribution.derivation_inflection: Noun number, case, and attached possessive/person suffixes account for singular/plural and referent differences.
layer_attribution.lexeme: faA and >afowa`h are each compatible with the bodily mouth in their audited occurrences.
layer_attribution.form: All rows are N; no derived-form contrast is available.
layer_attribution.construction: min marks source, bi marks means or instrument, fi marks containment, the 13:14 clause supplies a reaching relation, and khatm with ala marks a target in the audited local phrases.
layer_attribution.context_discourse: Speech content, sincerity contrasts, knowledge, truth, bodily testimony, and extinguishing supply local functions and evaluations.
layer_attribution.local_meaning: Recorded per phrase audit; three mechanisms remain expressly unresolved.
layer_attribution.final_statement: A strong universal bodily-mouth lexical finding is supportable; a preferred bare-root concept is not.

purity_diagnostics.details: No dictionary or external semantic frame was used.
Every observation terminates in one of the 13 exact active occurrence verses and its confirmed structural row.

Promoting a bodily-mouth lexical result to ROOT:fwh would collapse two noun lemma annotations and their shared structural key into an untested abstract root core; the final verdict contains this risk by leaving ROOT_CONCEPT unresolved.
Oral outlet, interface, and outward-expression formulations can be broadened to fit the same one-lexeme evidence without being discriminated; the final root result is therefore unresolved.

Restating the only observed lexical referent as the root concept would not add an independent derivative contrast; primary evidence remains resolvable, so the artifact limits rather than fabricates the conclusion.

candidate_reject_tests.rejection_condition: Any exact confirmed occurrence requires a bodily participant in a reaching, containment, or sealing relation without a speech-only reading.
Any exact occurrence is bodily or speech-related without falsehood or sincerity opposition.
A confirmed token must require a distinct non-mouth lexical referent or make the bodily noun incompatible after construction and context are separately attributed.
All semantic support is confined to one noun family with no independent derivative or form contrast capable of separating root contribution from lexical meaning.

lexeme_judgment.preferred_conclusion: Across the exact 13-token active structural set, the observed faA and >afowa`h noun lexemes denote the bodily mouth; source, instrument, containment, reaching, sealing, and discourse effects are supplied by construction and context.
lexeme_judgment.plain_explanation: The three most concrete cases place a mouth in a reaching relation involving water, mouths in a containment relation with hands, and mouths as sealed body parts alongside other body parts. The remaining cases use the same bodily noun as a source or means without turning it into speech, falsehood, breath, or outwardness itself.
unresolved_cases: The exact extinguishing mechanism in 9:32 and 61:8.
The exact gesture and purpose in 14:9.
The exact carrier of manifested hatred in 3:118.

rejection_condition.condition: Reopen or reject the universal bodily-mouth lexical finding if a confirmed active fwh token resolves to a distinct referent, if any of the 13 source or structural bindings changes, or if a local phrase cannot retain bodily mouth after construction and context are independently accounted for.

reopen_conditions: Any change to the production Tanzil snapshot, QAC hash, extraction revision, or attribution status of an fwh row.
Any newly admitted confirmed fwh token outside the current 13-token set.
Evidence that faA or >afowa`h has a non-mouth referent in one of the exact audited phrases.
A source-valid analysis showing that a hard case cannot preserve bodily mouth after local construction is separated.

root_concept_judgment.plain_explanation: Complete token coverage is not the same as derivative coverage. Every fwh token is a noun in the same bodily-mouth lexical family, so the evidence cannot independently identify what, if anything, belongs to an abstract root core rather than to the noun lexeme.
root_concept_judgment.semantic_boundary: The bodily-mouth lexical conclusion is retained below the root layer; speech, outward expression, oral instrumentality, and abstract aperture/interface formulations are not adopted as ROOT:fwh.
unresolved_cases: Whether concrete corporeality belongs to the root core or only to the observed noun lexemes.
Whether an oral aperture or interface abstraction is justified or merely a generic paraphrase.
Whether Quran-internal evidence permits any separately recoverable root abstraction for fwh.

rejection_condition.condition: Reject any preferred bare-root formulation that is supported only by restating faA or >afowa`h lexical meaning and lacks an independent derivative or form contrast.

reopen_conditions: A newly admitted confirmed fwh occurrence supplies a lexeme or derived form outside faA and >afowa`h.
A Quran-internal contrast separates a stable root contribution from noun-lexeme and constructional contributions.
A current-method revision supplies an accepted, non-circular way to infer root contribution from a one-lexeme corpus without importing external semantics.

alternatives: ROOT:fwh contributes the concrete bodily mouth itself.
ROOT:fwh contributes a more abstract oral aperture or interface while bodily corporeality belongs to the noun lexeme.
No root contribution separate from the observed faA and >afowa`h noun lexemes is recoverable from the Quran-internal distribution.
terminal_unresolved_alternative.why_not_discriminated: All 13 confirmed occurrences are nouns in the same lexical family; constructional diversity changes local role but never supplies an independent root-bearing derivative.
terminal_unresolved_alternative.required_disposition: Do not choose among these alternatives. Preserve the lexeme judgment and leave ROOT_CONCEPT unresolved.

to_retain_universal_lexeme_judgment: Maintain exact inspection of all 13 active confirmed tokens with both a Tanzil verse ref and QAC word-segment ref.
Retain the three bodily controls 13:14, 14:9, and 36:65.
Retain explicit treatment of both extinguishing hard cases 9:32 and 61:8 and all remaining source, speech, and instrument phrases.
Keep construction and context contributions outside the lexeme and root.
to_reopen_root_concept: At least one newly admitted confirmed fwh token from a genuinely distinct lexeme or derived form, not another inflection or occurrence of faA or >afowa`h.
At least one Quran-internal contrast that yields a falsifiable prediction distinguishing root contribution from lexeme, form, construction, and context.
Exact source-resolvable supporting and counterevidence refs for that contrast, including the strongest failure case.
A rejection condition that would fail the proposed root core without simultaneously rejecting the observed bodily-mouth lexemes.
to_resolve_extinguishing_local_mechanism: An admitted Quran-internal observation that explicitly discriminates breath, speech, or another means in the 9:32 and 61:8 construction; absent that observation, the mechanism remains unresolved.
